title: Cornucopias CopiCafe - Episode 5
description:

Listen to the corn-brains behind it all as they discuss Cornucopias' latest developments. Land Sale and pre mint tests, Elon Musk & Twitter, and land size leak.

Crack open your favorite beverage and enjoy this information-packed chat in the casual, comfy, corntastic episode of COPICafe!
